text.description_html:
Heavy Duty Grade 1 Surface Mounted Door Closer

Dorma's 8900 Series heavy-duty door closers are versatile, durable, reliable, and feature modern styling for institutional or high-traffic commercial applications.

The 8916 door closer is non-handed, and tri-packed for regular, top jamb and parallel arm applications. They are fully adjustable to meet interior and exterior barrier-free ADA requirements.

Packaged complete with fasteners for wood or metal doors and frames. Sex nuts and bolts are also furnished standard.

Specifications and Features: for Dorma 8916 Commercial Door Closer

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable Back Check
  • Corrosion Resistant, High Strength Aluminum Housing
  • Closer Body Length: 13"
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 5"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 2-1/8"
  • Maximum Door Weight: 180 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 48" interior / 42" exterior
  • Non Handed
  • ANSI/BHMA A156.4 Grade 1 Certified
  • UL 10C Approved
  • CSFM approved
  • Spring Size: 1-6
  • Aluminum finish
  • Tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting
  • Meets ANSI/BHMAS A117.1 and ADA for barrier-free acccessibility
  • 25 Year Warranty

The Dorma 8900 Series Closers are ADA Compliant offering adjustable spring power sizes 1 - 6 for use on interior doors requiring less than 5 lbs. of opening force and exterior doors requiring less than 8.5 lbs.
